hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market pools that applies VALS-formula fees (based on trade size, liquidity, and a signed volatility parameter σ from a trusted oracle) to every swap. Fees are taken from the collateral token via BeforeSwapDelta and distributed to share-token holders through a YieldDistributor; LP positions and yields are tracked across add/remove liquidity events.
